item.title: Show HN: A fruit fly on the web powered by the real FlyWire connectome
item.summary: I did a port of https://github.com/DenisSergeevitch/desktop-fly for my web desktop environment daedalOS: https://github.com/DustinBrett/daedalOS#desktopfly You can go to https://dustinbrett.com/?app=terminal and type "fly" to spawn one, or many. I also took the raw FlyWire data and increased the neuron count to 1,275. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49396322 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
